caveats: Shanterra Jackson filed a $10M federal lawsuit on May 21, 2024 alleging Senatobia, MS police officer Willie McNeil (Fox13 spells it 'Willis') sexually assaulted her during/after an Aug 25, 2023 traffic stop after turning off his body camera; defendants: City of Senatobia, Police Chief Richard Chandler, and McNeil. The $10M is damages sought, not a settlement. criminal_status: Mississippi Free Press (May 28, 2024) reports her attorney 'wanted to prosecute McNeil criminally,' indicating no charges filed as of publication; later status unverified. Department publicly denied the allegations. Two Tate Record sources whose URL slugs suggest the city/chief were later cleared and that the officer may have worked for a different department returned 403 and could not be read, so outcome and agency attribution could not be updated from them; outcome left as no_resolution_found. Also inaccessible: wreg.com and wjtv.com (403), localmemphis.com (timeout).
